description: An insight into the documents of the Senate of Latvia - a digital collection that offers access to the materials of the 1535th fund of the Latvian National Archives of the State History Archive of Latvia on the activities of the Senate of Latvia. Digitized documents are available on the platform, which mainly reflect the daily work of the Senate Judgments Office from mid-1939 to the end of 1940. In total, approximately 3,500 archive pages have been digitized, which provide an insight into court practice developments and the cultural and historical context of the institution's activities. These materials are only a small part of the vast collection of Senate documents held in the archives, but they offer an essential source for the study of legal history and the interwar period. It is intended for school youth and is written in Latvian and Latgalian literary language. With the help of a time machine, the player can visit the offices of 33 personalities important to the cultural history of Latgale in the period from 1870 to 2005. The game also includes tasks - searching for inappropriate objects and mini-games that reveal the personalities' hobbies and character, making learning about cultural heritage interactive and engaging.

description: Latvian NLP Tool Pipeline (NLP-PIPE) – a scalable toolkit for automatic analysis of the Latvian language, intended for both research and practical development of language technologies. It includes several components, including a morphological tagger, a syntactic parser, a named entity recognizer, a frame semantics parser, and an abstract meaning parser. NLP-PIPE is suitable for natural language processing researchers, programmers and companies that create language technology solutions for the Latvian language. The platform helps develop modern NLP tools and promotes the digital sustainability of the Latvian language.
